- Model consistently overestimates prices, especially in early forecast periods (first 5–10 days of 30d window).
- Overshoots after sharp price spikes (e.g., 38.18, 36.84) — model fails to correct downward quickly.
- Underestimates mean-reverting periods — model holds too high a mean, fails to adjust toward historical averages.
- Forecast lags behind true price movements — especially in mid-to-late 30d window, model is 1–2 days behind actual trend.
- Overconfidence in short-term momentum — model assumes continuation of recent trend, ignoring volatility or policy shifts.
- High variance in forecast error near end of 30d window — model struggles with late-period corrections or sudden drops.
- Model tends to smooth out volatility — underestimates sharp reversals or sudden spikes in true outcomes.
